dct_title_s: South Pacific Ocean : New Caledonia - South Coast. Port Noumea and Dumbea Bay
dct_description_sm: From surveys by U.S. Navy and Royal Australian Navy to 1944 with additions from French surveys to 1924.
Depths shown by soundings and tints; relief by hachures and spot heights.
Bar scales in nautical miles, yards, and meters.
Shows shoals, reefs, drainage, vegetation, wetlands, city plan, roads.
